title: Aggrega Per-Release Lockfile
description: Machine-generated lockfile pinning every URI resolved from a Release for deterministic future builds. Lives at `<release-stem>.lock` next to `<release-stem>.yaml`; produced by `aggrega pull <release>`; consumed by `aggrega build <release>`. Two provenance shapes serve two distinct closure-graph relationships: `referenced_from` (list of strings — dotted authoring-site paths) appears on `entities`, `cue_modules`, and `wasm_plugins` to record where in the Release / Aggregate / Manifest / `.aggrega-config.yaml` each URI was pulled in from; `consumers` (list of `{consumer_uri, fragments}` records) appears on `schema_libraries` and `mapping_libraries` to record which catalog entity references which `<entry-name>` fragments of a library — the structured shape makes consumer-affected-by-library-bump diffs traceable without re-running closure. Schema evolution discipline: adding a new top-level section is SemVer-MINOR (additive); adding a new field inside an existing section is SemVer-MINOR; removing a key or tightening a constraint is SemVer-MAJOR. The `cue_modules` section is retained indefinitely for third-party / enterprise catalogs that have not migrated to `SchemaLibrary` / `MappingLibrary` entities; the reader emits a deprecation diagnostic per populated entry but never auto-translates or breaks legacy lockfiles. A future additive `source_artifacts` section is reserved for the source-resolution amendment.

cue_modules.description: Legacy CUE-module pins for third-party / enterprise catalogs that have not migrated to SchemaLibrary / MappingLibrary entities. First-party Aggrega catalogs ship no CUE modules. The reader emits a deprecation diagnostic per populated entry; no auto-translation.

resolved_version.description: Concrete version resolved at pull time (e.g. `v1.0.0`).

digest.description: Content digest of the resolved module archive (e.g. `sha256:...`).

registry.description: Registry host the module resolved through.

referenced_from.description: Authoring-site origins — dotted paths into Release / Aggregate / Manifest YAML or `.aggrega-config.yaml` recording why this URI is in the closure.

cue_registry.description: Resolution-time snapshot of the workspace's CUE-module registry routing at pull time. Recorded for build-time drift verification — if the workspace cue_registry changes between pull and build, the build halts asking for a fresh pull.

default.description: Default registry host CUE-module imports resolved through at pull time.

overrides.description: Prefix-based routing overrides at pull time. Each entry routes module imports under the named prefix to the named registry.

entities.description: Catalog entities reachable from this Release: Component, Feature, Recipe, FeatureRecipe, Provider, Aggregate. Each entry is keyed by canonical URI and records the resolved version, content digest, resolution path, and the authoring-site origins (`referenced_from`) that pulled the URI into closure.

uri.description: Canonical URI of the catalog entity (e.g. `hub.aggrega.ai/component/core/compute/api-server`).

resolved_version.description: Concrete version the resolver selected at pull time (e.g. `1.2.3`).

digest.description: Content digest of the resolved artifact (e.g. `sha256:...`).

resolution_path.description: Diagnostic provenance tag describing which resolver tier returned the artifact (e.g. `tier3-registry`, `tier2-workspace`).

referenced_from.description: Authoring-site origins — dotted paths into Release / Aggregate / Manifest YAML (e.g. `aggregate.spec.components.api.type`) recording why this URI is in the closure.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the pull that produced this lockfile. Diagnostic provenance — records the wall-clock moment of resolution. Intentionally changes between pulls; not part of the WriteLockfile byte-identity guarantee.

mapping_libraries.description: MappingLibrary entries the closure references via Recipe / FeatureRecipe `valuesMapping: { $import: ... }` sites. Each entry's `consumers` list records which catalog entity references which `<entry-name>` fragments of the library — a structured record that makes library-version-bump impact diffs traceable without re-running closure.

release.description: Path to the Release this lockfile corresponds to, resolved relative to the lockfile's own directory (e.g. `./release-prod.yaml`). The per-Release naming convention places `<release-stem>.lock` next to `<release-stem>.yaml`; the relative path makes the lockfile self-describing without machine-specific absolute paths.

schema_libraries.description: SchemaLibrary entries the closure references via `$ref` and `$import:` sites in entity `schema:` / `usesSchema:` / `secretsSchema:` content. Each entry's `consumers` list records which catalog entity references which `<entry-name>` fragments of the library — a structured record that makes library-version-bump impact diffs traceable without re-running closure.

version.description: Lockfile schema version. Currently 1; future SemVer-MAJOR breaks of the schema increment this integer.

wasm_plugins.description: Wasm plugins the closure references — workspace-level plugin pins from `.aggrega-config.yaml` `plugins.{mutator,policy,linter,importer}[]:` plus any embedded plugin URIs from referenced Recipes / FeatureRecipes / Providers.

uri.description: Canonical URI of the Wasm plugin (e.g. `hub.aggrega.ai/wasm/aggrega-security-baseline`).

resolved_version.description: Concrete version resolved at pull time.

digest.description: Content digest of the resolved Wasm artifact (e.g. `sha256:...`).

referenced_from.description: Authoring-site origins — dotted paths recording why this URI is in the closure (e.g. `.aggrega-config.yaml.plugins.policy`).

LibraryEntry.description: Common shape shared by `schema_libraries` and `mapping_libraries` entries. The `consumers` list captures the catalog-graph relationship — which catalog entity references which `<entry-name>` fragments of this library — supporting structured impact diffs when the library's digest changes.

uri.description: Canonical URI of the library entity.

resolved_version.description: Concrete version resolved at pull time (MVS selection over the library-dependency graph).

digest.description: Content digest of the resolved library artifact (e.g. `sha256:...`).

consumers.description: Records of which catalog entity references this library and at which `<entry-name>` fragments. Captures the fan-in: many consumers per library, each potentially referencing many fragments. Each record carries the consumer URI plus the set of fragments that consumer pulls in.

consumer_uri.description: Canonical URI of the catalog entity (Component or Feature) referencing this library.

fragments.description: Set of `<entry-name>` fragments this consumer references within the library (e.g. `["#/schemas/PortSpec", "#/schemas/EndpointSpec"]`). Order is canonicalized lexicographically by the writer.
